operations.command: set -e; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i '/settings.disk.immutability.mode =/a\  settings.disk.immutability.nonPersistedGenerations = 4;' "$host"; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf retention-four-configured
set -e; echo ALPHA > /root/gen; sync; printf alpha-written
set -e; echo BETA > /root/gen; sync; printf beta-written
set -e; echo GAMMA > /root/gen; sync; printf gamma-written
set -e; echo DELTA > /root/gen; sync; printf delta-written

set -e; test ! -e /root/gen; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'path @snapshots/@root/generation-4'; ! btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'path @snapshots/@root/generation-5'; ! btrfs subvolume list / | grep -E 'path @snapshots/.*/[ABC]$'; printf four-generations-kept

set -e; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i 's/\.mode = "[^"]*"/.mode = "restore-generation"/g' "$host"; sed -i '/nonPersistedGenerations =/a\  settings.disk.immutability.restoreGeneration = 4;' "$host"; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf restore-four-configured

set -e; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i 's/\.mode = "[^"]*"/.mode = "reset"/g' "$host"; sed -i 's/nonPersistedGenerations = [0-9][0-9]*/nonPersistedGenerations = 0/' "$host"; sed -i '/restoreGeneration =/d' "$host"; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf retention-zero-configured
set -e; echo transient > /root/gone; sync; printf transient-written
set -e; test ! -e /root/gone; ! btrfs subvolume list / | grep -E 'path @snapshots/.*/(generation-[0-9]+|[ABC])$'; printf no-generations-kept
